chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 76: Yuan Er’s Flesh-Ritual and Bamboo Slip Awakening
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang sees Danyangzi’s evil influence growing. The boat captain Yuan Er returns with a grotesque self-mutilating ritual and a red bamboo slip that might summon something far older and hungrier.
og_title: The Bamboo Slip Speaks – A New Horror Awakens
og_description: Li Huowang fights a desperate battle as Yuan Er feeds his own teeth, eye, and throat to a sinister bamboo slip. The cost of survival is rising.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 76: Yuan Er’s Teeth Become Bullets
twitter_description: A crimson bamboo slip turns a dying man into a living weapon. Li Huowang’s Wandering Lords aren’t enough this time.
